positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Created point-cloud samples by setting up 10 sets of IR & RGB cameras and filtering 100+ pictures for each figure
• Researched on Surface Reconstruction from unorganized points, under the supervision of Prof. Kwan Sik Kim
• Generated meshes from point-cloud samples and textured them, using Poisson Surface Recon and Ball Pivoting method
• Explained the process and the technology of 3D volumetric rendering and Free-viewpoint video to the 3D artist team

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a cryptocurrency arbitrage simulator and tested new oscillator strategy to maximize the profit while lowering the risk
• Imported the actual bid/ask prices of various cryptocurrency from public sources, such as Bittrex, and implemented a SQL database to store and keep track of the user’s transaction history and current balance
• Conducted comprehensive unit tests and analysis to assure the quality of KT’s network/database cloud server

positions.title: Sergeant Translator

projects.title: Road Runner: Errand Service Application
projects.description:
• Developed and launched errand service platform for college students in iOS and Android environment, in group of 5
• Implemented backend server and REST API for user authentication and errand request management using Node.js and MySQL database

projects.title: Monte Carlo Path Tracer
projects.description:
• Developed Monte Carlo Path Tracer with Global Illumination effect using Monte Carlo estimation with Multiple Importance Sampling
• Implemented various surface materials, lights, path tracing methods, and Constructive Solid Geometry, and optimized render-speed using K-d tree
